question: Do independently published UV/symmetry mechanisms proposed before the current RTK soft-s obstruction provide an explicit action-level low-energy matching map that uniquely fixes the universal-HMT matter-interface relation relevant to RTK response?

independent_sources.role: supersymmetric-matter/Lifshitz-gravity protection candidate; audit whether it derives the HMT universal-interface constants or an equivalent physical-ADM matching map
strong-dynamics emergent-Lorentz-invariance candidate; audit whether it derives the HMT universal-interface constants or an equivalent physical-ADM matching map
reference definition of the universal HMT physical-ADM interface and its arbitrary constants a1,a2

decision_rule: MATCH_FOUND requires at least one audited independent completion to provide an explicit action-level map into the universal-HMT physical matter interface that fixes every scalar-response-relevant interface parameter without using RTK pole/residue/remainder, soft-s data, or k=0.03 production. CANDIDATE_PROTECTION_NO_MATCH applies when the audited sources establish concrete supersymmetric and/or strong-dynamics protection mechanisms for Lorentz restoration but do not formulate the universal HMT physical-ADM interface and do not derive a1,a2 or an equivalent unique matching relation. INCOMPLETE applies if the source statements cannot be locked. This is an audited-source inventory, not a literature-wide no-go and not C9 closure.
required_guards: sources predate the current RTK soft-s obstruction
do not infer HMT matching from generic suppression of Lorentz violation
do not identify a Lifshitz scalar-gravity toy model with HMT without an explicit map
do not identify generic holographic strong dynamics with the HMT matter interface without an explicit map
do not choose a1 or a2 from RTK response
do not claim C9 naturalness closure
